body:
📦 **ArtGallery `e1008a0`** — feat(gallery): exhibit Dew Beacon in a new interactive 3D model section

Add the original brass-and-jade Dew Beacon sculpture, editable Blender source,
GLB model, studio render and modelling script. Register Models3D exhibits in the
gallery index and provide an isolated WebGL viewer with orbit, zoom, reset and
model downloads. Document the model exhibition and publishing workflow.

Validation: Blender MCP scene inspection; 76 exported meshes and 28,460 triangles;
GLB embedding matches the source bytes; gallery build and --check pass; Python
compilation and JavaScript syntax checks pass; browser verifies section filtering,
view controls, both downloads and iframe disposal with no console errors.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

環架掃掠若在近垂直切線處更換參考軸，管面會突然扭轉，渲染出可見斷口。
改用平行傳輸維持截面方向；這是作品幾何的局部實作修正，無需另開任務討論。
沙盒 iframe 不允許下載，內嵌觀看時隱藏下載按鈕並由畫廊外層提供，避免死按鈕。

👥 參與者：@meadow

---
